verdict.rationale: Productboard documents an official, first-party hosted MCP server at https://mcp.productboard.com that any agent can connect to, including Claude, ChatGPT, Claude Code, Codex and Cursor. Sign-in uses browser OAuth with Dynamic Client Registration and PKCE, admins enable it per workspace and choose which roles may connect, and the server can create and update features, initiatives, releases, OKRs, feedback and documents, with install and example docs. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that connecting an agent works as documented.
